sprint: Planned Example Completion Gap Analysis and Full-Coverage Generation Design
phase: Phase 3 — Full Planned Example Completion Feasibility

feasibility_questions.question: Can the current system guarantee all planned examples are generated?
feasibility_questions.reason: The system generates code via LLM. LLM output is non-deterministic. The LLM may hallucinate wrong classes (proven: PluginOptions instead of SplitOptions), use wrong APIs (proven: TextAbsorber instead of TextExtractor in prior runs), or produce incomplete code.
feasibility_questions.missing_capability: Deterministic code generation fallback — when LLM fails N times, use a template-based fallback with known-good patterns
feasibility_questions.proposed_fix: Add type-specific few-shot examples to LLM prompt. Add code validator rules that reject known-bad patterns. Add template fallback after max repair attempts.
feasibility_questions.acceptance_criteria: Splitter and Optimizer generate with correct concrete options class on first attempt or after one repair.

feasibility_questions.question: Can it guarantee all generated examples build?
feasibility_questions.reason: Build-repair loop (max 2 attempts) feeds compiler errors back to LLM. This works well for simple errors but fails for fundamental API misunderstandings (e.g., PluginOptions is abstract). The repair prompt does not include the correct concrete class name.
feasibility_questions.missing_capability: Repair prompt enrichment — include the source-of-truth API catalog in the repair context so LLM can see the correct class
feasibility_questions.proposed_fix: Include the paired_options field from type-role-classification in the repair prompt. E.g., 'Splitter uses SplitOptions, not PluginOptions.'
feasibility_questions.acceptance_criteria: Repair prompt always includes the correct options class name when the error is about abstract class instantiation.

feasibility_questions.question: Can it guarantee all built examples run?
feasibility_questions.reason: Runtime-repair loop (max 1 attempt) handles some failures but not all. Some runtime failures are environmental (license evaluation mode), some are API-specific (wrong overload).
feasibility_questions.missing_capability: Expanded repairable classifications (e.g., abstract_class_instantiation), more repair attempts (currently 1), runtime failure pattern library
feasibility_questions.proposed_fix: Increase max_runtime_repairs from 1 to 2. Add PluginOptions instantiation as a repairable classification. Include API catalog excerpt in runtime repair prompt.
feasibility_questions.acceptance_criteria: Runtime repair attempts increased; abstract class runtime errors become repairable.

feasibility_questions.question: Can it guarantee all running examples produce expected outputs?
feasibility_questions.reason: Output validation depends on expected-output.json with must_contain patterns. These are generated alongside the code but may not match actual output. No format-specific validators exist for DOC, PPTX, XLSX, image formats.
feasibility_questions.missing_capability: Format-specific output validators, dynamic expected-output generation based on actual API behavior
feasibility_questions.proposed_fix: Add output validators for each output format. PDF: check %PDF header + page count. DOCX: extract text from XML. XLSX: check worksheet presence. Image: check file header bytes.
feasibility_questions.acceptance_criteria: Each output format has at least a basic structural validator.

feasibility_questions.question: Can it guarantee reviewer pass?
feasibility_questions.reason: Reviewer is an external subprocess (example-reviewer). It may be unavailable (EXAMPLE_REVIEWER_PATH not set). When available, it returns pass/fail only — no per-example feedback. No reviewer-repair loop exists.
feasibility_questions.missing_capability: Structured reviewer feedback, reviewer-repair loop, reviewer availability guarantee
feasibility_questions.proposed_fix: Implement structured ReviewerResult.findings (RC-1 through RC-5 from gap analysis). Add reviewer-repair loop in runner.py.
feasibility_questions.acceptance_criteria: Reviewer returns per-example findings. Generator can use findings to fix code.

feasibility_questions.question: Can it recover from all LLM API mistakes?
feasibility_questions.reason: Build-repair (2 attempts) and runtime-repair (1 attempt) cover basic mistakes. But fundamental API misunderstandings (wrong class hierarchy, wrong method signatures) are not recoverable because the repair prompt lacks the source-of-truth API catalog excerpt.
feasibility_questions.missing_capability: API-catalog-enriched repair prompts, type-specific few-shot fallbacks, deterministic template fallback after max repairs
feasibility_questions.proposed_fix: Include type_role_classification.paired_options and validated code patterns (from fixture harness) in repair prompts.
feasibility_questions.acceptance_criteria: Repair prompt includes correct method signatures and options class names from source-of-truth.

feasibility_questions.question: Can it learn across runs?
feasibility_questions.reason: Each run starts fresh. The backlog records failure patterns but they are not fed into the next run's LLM prompts. No cross-run learning mechanism exists.
feasibility_questions.missing_capability: Backlog-to-prompt feedback loop — read previous failure patterns and inject them as negative examples or few-shots
feasibility_questions.proposed_fix: Read backlog entries at prompt-building time. Inject 'do NOT use pattern X' based on prior failures.
feasibility_questions.acceptance_criteria: A scenario with a backlog entry includes the failure pattern as a negative constraint in the LLM prompt.

feasibility_questions.question: Can it complete examples needing new fixture strategy?
feasibility_questions.reason: The fixture system supports programmatic single-file input (template_hints.input_creation_lines). It does not support: paired inputs (2+ files), template-with-merge-fields, template-with-data-tags, PDFs with form fields, PDFs with signatures.
feasibility_questions.missing_capability: Fixture strategy registry: define per-type fixture requirements, generate appropriate input files, support multi-file scenarios
feasibility_questions.proposed_fix: Extend template_hints with per-type fixture definitions. Add merger_input_creation_lines (already exists for Words). Add mail_merge_template_creation_lines. For PDF: add form_field_pdf_creation_lines.
feasibility_questions.acceptance_criteria: Comparer scenario can generate 2 different input DOCX files programmatically.

feasibility_questions.question: Can it complete examples needing enum value discovery?
feasibility_questions.reason: DllReflector does not output enum values. SplitCriteria enum in Words has unknown values. The scenario planner cannot build a scenario requiring an enum it cannot enumerate.
feasibility_questions.proposed_fix: Add --enum-values flag to DllReflector. Output enum names and integer values for all public enum types.
feasibility_questions.acceptance_criteria: DllReflector catalog includes SplitCriteria.SectionBreak, SplitCriteria.PageBreak, etc.

feasibility_questions.question: Can it complete examples needing structured reviewer feedback?
feasibility_questions.reason: ReviewerResult is pass/fail only. No per-example findings. No reviewer-repair loop. Reviewer failure is terminal.
feasibility_questions.acceptance_criteria: Reviewer returns per-example findings with severity/file/message. Runner can feed findings into LLM repair prompt.

primary_blockers: LLM non-determinism without few-shot guidance (Q1, Q2, Q6)
Missing fixture strategies for complex scenarios (Q8)
